description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 04.02.2019 to 10.02.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs valuations and payments should be calculated. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory compliance requirements for customs operations.
